The administrative expenses include an amount of $30 000 for a machine purchased on

nil proceeds. Any costs related to the machine should be charged to the cost of sales.
The figure for land and buildings (at cost) includes land which had cost $300 000.
During the year, XY plc purchased a motor vehicle which cost $60 000. This was settled by a
payment of $40 000 from the bank and the part exchange of an old vehicle. This old vehicle

had been recorded in the books of account.
Depreciation is to be charged on the following basis:
Buildings straight-line method over 25 years, charged to cost of sales
Equipment straight-line method over 5 years, charged to administrative expenses
Motor vehicles reducing balance method at 20% per annum, charged to distribution
The company policy is to charge a full year’s depreciation in the year of purchase and none

4% is to be maintained. These items need to be included in administrative expenses.

3 Greaves and Hurst participated in a joint venture sharing profits and losses in the ratio 2 : 1.
Greaves provided goods valued at $15 000 and incurred costs of $900.
Hurst provided goods valued at $10 000 and incurred costs of $800.
Greaves sold all of the goods for $35 000.
It was agreed that a commission of 10% of the sales value would be paid to the person making
the sale.
The joint venture was then dissolved.
REQUIRED

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Calculate the share of profit made by Greaves and Hurst from the joint venture. 
Additional information
A separate set of books of account are maintained to record the transactions of the joint venture.
Greaves and Hurst kept their own transactions with the joint venture in their own books.
REQUIRED

parts.label: (ii)

Following the closure of the joint venture, Greaves and Hurst have received more orders and are
considering forming a partnership.
REQUIRED

parts.text:
Advise Greaves and Hurst whether or not they should form a partnership. Justify your
answer by discussing advantages and disadvantages of forming the partnership.
